license: CC BY-NC 3.0 (archive site declaration); local evaluation only
review: Independent publisher human transcript and fixed bandpass/Hilbert envelope timings at four known thresholds .055/.060/.065/.075. Complete-word unambiguous crops only; no app/neural outputs used. Crop selection and labels frozen before candidate evaluation.
limits: One transmitter/receiver session, correlated crops, with noise reduction already applied by the receiver. Only unambiguous portions are scored; this does not represent all real-world reception. Upstream pretrained-model contamination cannot be ruled out.
access: Whole source session excluded from training and development. Reveal private manifest only after root candidate freeze; then append immutable full manifest as neural/corpus-final-v2.json for reproducibility.
